package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/config"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/catalogclient"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/courseclient"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/filestorage"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/practiceruntime"
	sandboxadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/sandbox"
	sandboxruntimeadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/sandboxclient"
	validationruntimeadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/validationclient"
	natsadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	pgadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/runtime/builders"
	studentruntimeadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/runtime/studentruntime"
	taskprovideradapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/runtime/taskprovider"
	validatoradapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/runtime/validators"
	httpadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http"
	adminhandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	internalapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	natsconsumer "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	hybridapplication "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/hybridapplication"
	outboxuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/outbox"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
)

type systemClock struct{}

func (systemClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now() }

type uuidGenerator struct{}

func (uuidGenerator) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

func main() {
	logger, _ := zap.NewProduction()
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("config error: %v", err)
	}
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("config validation error: %v", err)
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	pool, err := pgadapter.Connect(ctx, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("db error: %v", err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()

	natsConn, err := nats.Connect(cfg.NATSURL)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("nats connection error", zap.Error(err))
	}
	defer func() {
		if natsConn != nil {
			if err := natsConn.Drain(); err != nil {
				logger.Warn("nats drain error", zap.Error(err))
			}
		}
	}()

	validator := validator.New()
	publisher := &natsadapter.EventPublisher{Conn: natsConn}
	commandPublisher := &natsadapter.CommandPublisher{Conn: natsConn}
	answerRepo := pgadapter.StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	autoReviewRepo := pgadapter.AutoReviewRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	manualReviewRepo := pgadapter.ManualReviewRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	taskTestAnswerVariantRepo := pgadapter.TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	studentPracticeTaskRepo := &pgadapter.StudentPracticeTaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	studentPositionRepo := &pgadapter.StudentPositionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	studentOnboardingRepo := &pgadapter.StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseAssignmentRepo := &pgadapter.CourseAssignmentRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	assignmentAccess := studentuc.GetStudentCourses{Assignments: courseAssignmentRepo}
	courseClient := courseclient.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.CourseServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken,
		AssignmentAccess: assignmentAccess,
	}
	// Learning-path writers discover migration 025 inside their transaction.  That
	// keeps standalone repository construction safe and lets flag-off deploys
	// continue fencing reservations created before traffic was drained.
	learningJourneyRepo := &pgadapter.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	if cfg.OnboardingPathAdmissionEnabled {
		var admissionSchemaInstalled bool
		if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('public.student_onboarding_path_admission') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&admissionSchemaInstalled); err != nil {
			logger.Fatal("check S9 onboarding path admission schema", zap.Error(err))
		}
		if !admissionSchemaInstalled {
			logger.Fatal("S9 onboarding path admission schema is required when enabled")
		}
	}
	onboardingPathAdmissions := &pgadapter.OnboardingPathAdmissionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	diagnosticAssessmentRepo := &pgadapter.DiagnosticAssessmentRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	learningEvidenceRepo := &pgadapter.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	learningActionRepo := &pgadapter.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	outboxRepo := &pgadapter.OutboxRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	outboxPublisher := &natsadapter.OutboxPublisher{Conn: natsConn}
	outboxRelay := outboxuc.Relay{
		Outbox:         outboxRepo,
		Publisher:      outboxPublisher,
		Clock:          systemClock{},
		WorkerID:       "student-" + uuid.NewString(),
		BatchSize:      cfg.OutboxBatchSize,
		LockTTL:        time.Duration(cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds) * time.Second,
		PublishTimeout: time.Duration(cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds) * time.Second,
		RetryBaseDelay: time.Duration(cfg.OutboxRetryBaseSeconds) * time.Second,
		RetryMaxDelay:  time.Duration(cfg.OutboxRetryMaxSeconds) * time.Second,
	}
	if err := outboxRelay.Validate(); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("outbox relay configuration error", zap.Error(err))
	}
	relayContext, stopRelay := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	var relayWaitGroup sync.WaitGroup
	relayWaitGroup.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer relayWaitGroup.Done()
		runOutboxRelay(
			relayContext,
			logger,
			outboxRelay,
			time.Duration(cfg.OutboxPollIntervalMS)*time.Millisecond,
		)
	}()
	defer func() {
		stopRelay()
		relayWaitGroup.Wait()
	}()

	// Create sandbox client
	sandboxNATSClient := natsadapter.NewSandboxClient(natsConn, domain.SubjectSandboxArchiveAndUpload)
	sandboxClient := sandboxadapter.NewCombinedClient(cfg.SandboxServiceBaseURL, cfg.SandboxServiceInternalToken, sandboxNATSClient)
	sandboxCreator := sandboxadapter.NewSandboxCreator(cfg.SandboxServiceBaseURL, cfg.SandboxServiceInternalToken)

	// Create validator factory
	validatorFactory := validatoradapter.NewFactory(
		natsConn,
		cfg.HTMLValidatorURL,
		cfg.HTMLValidatorSubject,
		cfg.CSSValidatorSubject,
		cfg.PHPValidatorURL,
		cfg.NodeValidatorURL,
		cfg.ReactValidatorURL,
	)
	validationOrchestrator := validatoradapter.NewOrchestratorClient(cfg.ValidationOrchestratorURL, cfg.ValidationOrchestratorInternalToken)
	publicationFiles, err := filestorage.NewClient(cfg.FileStorageURL, cfg.FileStorageInternalToken, cfg.PracticeTaskPublicationEncryptionKey)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("practice task publication filestorage configuration error", zap.Error(err))
	}

	catalogClient := catalogclient.Client{BaseURL: cfg.PracticeTaskOrchestratorURL, InternalToken: cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken}
	runtimeSandbox := sandboxruntimeadapter.Client{BaseURL: cfg.SandboxServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.SandboxServiceInternalToken}
	buildUseCase := studentuc.BuildUseCase{Builders: builders.NewRegistry()}
	studentUseCase := studentuc.StudentUseCase{
		Catalog:       catalogClient,
		Students:      studentPracticeTaskRepo,
		Answers:       answerRepo,
		Builders:      buildUseCase,
		Completion:    courseclient.CompletionClient{BaseURL: cfg.CourseServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken},
		CourseContent: courseClient,
		Sandbox:       runtimeSandbox,
		Validation: validationruntimeadapter.Client{
			BaseURL:       cfg.ValidationOrchestratorURL,
			InternalToken: cfg.ValidationOrchestratorInternalToken,
		},
		AIReview:         aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: cfg.AIPromptServiceURL, InternalToken: cfg.AIPromptInternalToken},
		Publications:     studentPracticeTaskRepo,
		PublicationFiles: publicationFiles,
	}
	studentPositionUseCase := studentuc.PositionUseCase{Positions: studentPositionRepo}
	getStudentOnboarding := studentuc.GetStudentOnboarding{Profiles: studentOnboardingRepo}
	putStudentOnboarding := studentuc.PutStudentOnboarding{Profiles: studentOnboardingRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	getStudentOnboardingDraft := studentuc.GetStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: studentOnboardingRepo}
	putStudentOnboardingDraft := studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: studentOnboardingRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	finalizeStudentOnboardingDraft := studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: studentOnboardingRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	applyStudentOnboardingTurn := studentuc.ApplyStudentOnboardingTurn{Turns: studentOnboardingRepo, Clock: systemClock{}, EffectsEnabled: cfg.TeacherOnboardingTurnV2Enabled}
	getStudentOnboardingTurn := studentuc.GetStudentOnboardingTurn{Turns: studentOnboardingRepo}
	proveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect := studentuc.ProveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect{Turns: studentOnboardingRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	assignCourse := studentuc.AssignCourse{Assignments: courseAssignmentRepo, Clock: systemClock{}, IDs: uuidGenerator{}}
	getStudentCourses := assignmentAccess
	getLearnerOverview := studentuc.GetLearnerOverview{Profiles: studentOnboardingRepo, Mastery: learningEvidenceRepo, Journey: learningJourneyRepo}
	getStudentPlanningReadiness := studentuc.GetStudentPlanningReadiness{Reader: studentOnboardingRepo}
	getLearningWorkspace := studentuc.GetLearningWorkspace{Reader: learningJourneyRepo, Enabled: cfg.LearningWorkspaceSnapshotEnabled}
	teacherAssistanceUseCase := studentuc.ApplyTeacherAssistance{Evidence: learningEvidenceRepo}
	practiceEvidenceUseCase := studentuc.ApplyPracticeEvidence{Evidence: learningEvidenceRepo}
	practiceLearningEvidenceUseCase := studentuc.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence{Actions: learningActionRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	targetMasteryUseCase := studentuc.GetTargetMastery{Mastery: learningEvidenceRepo}
	learningActionContextUseCase := studentuc.GetLearningActionContext{Actions: learningActionRepo}
	learningActionCodeContextUseCase := studentuc.GetLearningActionCodeContext{Actions: learningActionRepo, Sandbox: runtimeSandbox}
	replaceLearningPath := studentuc.ReplaceLearningPath{Revisions: courseClient, Journey: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}, IDs: uuidGenerator{}}
	assignedLessons := studentuc.AssignedLessonContext{Paths: learningJourneyRepo}
	learningPaths := studentuc.LearningPaths{Paths: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	learningPathPlanning := studentuc.LearningPathPlanning{Revisions: courseClient, Paths: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	hybridApplication := hybridapplication.Service{Applications: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	hybridIntentHandler := &handlers.StudentHybridIntentHandler{Intents: hybridApplication}
	practiceLearningActions := studentuc.PracticeLearningActions{Actions: learningActionRepo, Clock: systemClock{}, IDs: uuidGenerator{}}
	completeLearningPath := studentuc.CompleteLearningPath{Journey: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}
	onboardingPathAdmission := studentuc.OnboardingPathAdmissionService{Revisions: courseClient, Admissions: onboardingPathAdmissions, Clock: systemClock{}, IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Enabled: cfg.OnboardingPathAdmissionEnabled}
	captureDiagnostic := studentuc.CaptureDiagnosticSnapshot{
		Journey: learningJourneyRepo, Mastery: targetMasteryUseCase, Clock: systemClock{}, IDs: uuidGenerator{},
	}
	learningSessions := studentuc.LearningSessions{Journey: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}, IDs: uuidGenerator{}}
	diagnosticAssessments := studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{
		Attempts: diagnosticAssessmentRepo,
		Catalog:  courseclient.DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: cfg.CourseServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken},
		Tasks:    courseClient, Clock: systemClock{},
	}
	studentRuntimeBridge := studentruntimeadapter.LocalBridge{Students: studentUseCase}
	taskProvider := taskprovideradapter.Composite{Primary: studentRuntimeBridge, Secondary: courseClient}
	progressionService := &answer.ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider:       taskProvider,
		Lessons:            courseClient,
		Answers:            answerRepo,
		PracticeTaskAccess: studentUseCase,
	}

	startUC := answer.StartTaskAnswer{LessonAssignments: answerRepo, TaskProvider: taskProvider, Answers: answerRepo, LearningActions: learningActionRepo, Publisher: publisher, SandboxCreator: sandboxCreator, Progression: progressionService, PracticeTaskRuntime: studentRuntimeBridge}
	submitUC := answer.SubmitTaskAnswer{Answers: answerRepo, TaskProvider: taskProvider, Progression: progressionService}
	finalValidationUC := answer.FinalValidation{
		Answers:                answerRepo,
		TaskTestAnswers:        taskTestAnswerVariantRepo,
		TaskProvider:           taskProvider,
		Progression:            progressionService,
		SandboxClient:          sandboxClient,
		ValidatorFactory:       validatorFactory,
		ValidationOrchestrator: validationOrchestrator,
		Publisher:              publisher,
		CommandPublisher:       commandPublisher,
		AutoReviews:            autoReviewRepo,
		LearningActions:        learningActionRepo,
		PracticeTaskRuntime:    studentRuntimeBridge,
	}
	studentUseCase.AnswerStarter = startUC
	studentUseCase.FinalValidator = finalValidationUC
	listUC := answer.ListStudentAnswers{Answers: answerRepo}
	getUC := answer.GetStudentAnswer{Answers: answerRepo, AutoReviews: autoReviewRepo, ManualReviews: manualReviewRepo}
	listResultsUC := answer.ListStudentResults{Answers: answerRepo, TaskProvider: taskProvider, SandboxResolver: sandboxClient}
	getResultUC := answer.GetStudentResult{GetAnswer: getUC, Answers: answerRepo, TaskProvider: taskProvider, SandboxResolver: sandboxClient}
	manualUC := answer.ApplyManualReview{Answers: answerRepo, ManualReviews: manualReviewRepo, LearningActions: learningActionRepo, Publisher: publisher}
	autoUC := answer.ApplyAutoReview{Answers: answerRepo, AutoReviews: autoReviewRepo, ManualReviews: manualReviewRepo, LearningActions: learningActionRepo, Publisher: publisher}

	inprocessUC := answer.InProcessAnswer{
		Answers:         answerRepo,
		AllowedServices: []string{"ms-go-sandbox"},
	}
	activityUC := answer.ActivityAnswer{
		Answers:         answerRepo,
		TaskProvider:    taskProvider,
		LearningActions: learningActionRepo,
	}

	answerHandler := &handlers.AnswerHandler{
		Validator:   validator,
		Start:       startUC,
		Progress:    progressionService,
		Submit:      submitUC,
		SubmitById:  finalValidationUC,
		List:        listUC,
		Get:         getUC,
		ListResults: listResultsUC,
		GetResult:   getResultUC,
		Manual:      manualUC,
	}
	studentRuntimeHandler := &handlers.StudentRuntimeHandler{
		Students: studentUseCase,
	}
	studentPracticeTaskHandler := &handlers.StudentPracticeTaskHandler{
		Validator:  validator,
		Students:   studentUseCase,
		Runtime:    *studentRuntimeHandler,
		Progress:   progressionService,
		Start:      startUC,
		Submit:     submitUC,
		SubmitById: finalValidationUC,
		Get:        getUC,
	}
	studentPositionHandler := &handlers.StudentPositionHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		Positions: studentPositionUseCase,
	}
	studentOnboardingHandler := &handlers.StudentOnboardingHandler{
		Get: getStudentOnboarding, Put: putStudentOnboarding,
		GetDraft: getStudentOnboardingDraft, PutDraft: putStudentOnboardingDraft,
		FinalizeDraft: finalizeStudentOnboardingDraft,
	}
	studentCourseAssignmentHandler := &handlers.StudentCourseAssignmentHandler{Courses: getStudentCourses}
	nextAction := studentuc.NextActionResolver{Reader: learningJourneyRepo, Runtime: practiceruntime.Client{BaseURL: cfg.PracticeRuntimeURL, InternalToken: cfg.PracticeRuntimeInternalToken}}
	studentLearningJourneyHandler := &handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler{
		AssignedLessons: assignedLessons,
		NextAction:      nextAction,
		Completion:      studentuc.LessonCompletion{Repository: learningJourneyRepo, Clock: systemClock{}}, Paths: studentuc.GetLearningPath{Journey: learningJourneyRepo}, PathCollection: learningPaths,
		Diagnostics: learningJourneyRepo, Sessions: learningSessions,
	}
	diagnosticAssessmentHandler := &handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentHandler{Assessments: diagnosticAssessments}

	internalHandler := internalapi.NewHandler(
		answerRepo, studentPracticeTaskRepo, targetMasteryUseCase, learningActionContextUseCase, getLearnerOverview,
	)
	internalHandler.AssignedLessons = assignedLessons
	internalHandler.NextAction = nextAction
	internalHandler.LearningPaths = replaceLearningPath
	internalHandler.LearningPathCompletion = completeLearningPath
	internalHandler.LearningPathPlanning = learningPathPlanning
	internalHandler.Diagnostics = captureDiagnostic
	internalHandler.LearningSessions = learningSessions
	internalHandler.LearningCode = learningActionCodeContextUseCase
	internalHandler.CourseAssignments = assignCourse
	internalHandler.PracticeEvidence = practiceEvidenceUseCase
	internalHandler.PracticeLearningActions = practiceLearningActions
	internalHandler.PracticeLearningEvidence = practiceLearningEvidenceUseCase
	internalHandler.DiagnosticAssessments = &diagnosticAssessments
	internalHandler.OnboardingDrafts = getStudentOnboardingDraft
	internalHandler.OnboardingDraftWrites = putStudentOnboardingDraft
	internalHandler.OnboardingFinalization = finalizeStudentOnboardingDraft
	internalHandler.OnboardingProfiles = getStudentOnboarding
	internalHandler.OnboardingTurnApply = applyStudentOnboardingTurn
	internalHandler.OnboardingTurns = getStudentOnboardingTurn
	internalHandler.OnboardingTurnProofs = proveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect
	internalHandler.PlanningReadiness = getStudentPlanningReadiness
	internalHandler.PlanningSnapshot = studentuc.GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: learningJourneyRepo}
	internalHandler.HybridApplication = hybridApplication
	// S10 is intentionally read-only and defaults off. The use case returns a
	// disabled error before it asks PostgreSQL for a workspace projection.
	internalHandler.LearningWorkspace = getLearningWorkspace
	// Keep the Planner-only contract explicit while flag-off; the use case exits before
	// any admission-table query and returns the documented disabled error.
	internalHandler.OnboardingPathAdmissions = onboardingPathAdmission
	router := httpadapter.NewRouter(httpadapter.RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler:                  answerHandler,
		StudentPositionHandler:         studentPositionHandler,
		StudentPracticeTaskHandler:     studentPracticeTaskHandler,
		StudentRuntimeHandler:          studentRuntimeHandler,
		StudentOnboardingHandler:       studentOnboardingHandler,
		StudentLearningJourneyHandler:  studentLearningJourneyHandler,
		StudentCourseAssignmentHandler: studentCourseAssignmentHandler,
		DiagnosticAssessmentHandler:    diagnosticAssessmentHandler,
		HybridIntentHandler:            hybridIntentHandler,
		AdminReviewHandlers: adminhandlers.ReviewHandlers{
			ManualReview:                   answerHandler.ManualReview,
			ListPendingPracticeTaskReviews: studentPracticeTaskHandler.ListPendingPracticeTaskFinalReviews,
			GetPracticeTaskReview:          studentPracticeTaskHandler.GetPracticeTaskFinalReviewForReviewer,
			ReviewPracticeTaskSubmission:   studentPracticeTaskHandler.ReviewPracticeTaskFinalSubmission,
			RetryPracticeTaskAIReview:      studentPracticeTaskHandler.RetryPracticeTaskAIReview,
		},
		InternalHandler:              internalHandler,
		InternalToken:                cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken,
		LearningPlannerInternalToken: cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken,
		TeacherInternalToken:         cfg.TeacherInternalToken,
		PracticeTaskInternalToken:    cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken,
		LegacyPracticeWritesEnabled:  cfg.LegacyPracticeRuntimeWritesEnabled,
	})

	subscriber := natsconsumer.AutoReviewSubscriber{
		Conn:    natsConn,
		Subject: domain.SubjectTaskAnswerAutoChecked,
		Queue:   "ms-student-service",
		Handler: func(ctx context.Context, msg []byte) error {
			var payload struct {
				StudentTaskAnswerID string         `json:"student_task_answer_id"`
				ValidatorName       string         `json:"validator_name"`
				AutoScore           *float64       `json:"auto_score"`
				Passed              bool           `json:"passed"`
				Feedback            *string        `json:"feedback"`
				RawResult           map[string]any `json:"raw_result"`
				CheckedAt           *time.Time     `json:"checked_at"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &payload); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_, err := autoUC.Handle(ctx, answer.ApplyAutoReviewInput{
				StudentTaskAnswerID: payload.StudentTaskAnswerID,
				ValidatorName:       payload.ValidatorName,
				AutoScore:           payload.AutoScore,
				Passed:              payload.Passed,
				Feedback:            payload.Feedback,
				RawResult:           payload.RawResult,
				CheckedAt:           payload.CheckedAt,
			})
			return err
		},
	}
	if err := subscriber.Subscribe(ctx); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("nats subscribe error", zap.Error(err))
	}

	// Subscribe to inprocess command
	inprocessSubscriber := natsconsumer.InProcessSubscriber{
		Conn:    natsConn,
		Subject: domain.SubjectTaskAnswerInProcess,
		Queue:   "ms-student-service",
		Handler: func(ctx context.Context, msg []byte, headers map[string]string) error {
			var payload struct {
				AnswerID      string `json:"answerId"`
				FileStorageID string `json:"fileStorageId"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &payload); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			// Validate required fields
			if payload.AnswerID == "" || payload.FileStorageID == "" {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}

			// Extract headers
			userID := headers["x-user-id"]
			userRole := headers["x-user-role"]
			serviceName := headers["x-service-name"]

			if userID == "" || userRole == "" || serviceName == "" {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}

			return inprocessUC.Handle(ctx, answer.InProcessAnswerInput{
				AnswerID:      payload.AnswerID,
				FileStorageID: payload.FileStorageID,
				StudentID:     userID,
				UserRole:      userRole,
				ServiceName:   serviceName,
			})
		},
	}
	if err := inprocessSubscriber.Subscribe(ctx); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("nats inprocess subscribe error", zap.Error(err))
	}

	// Subscribe to activity command
	activitySubscriber := natsconsumer.ActivitySubscriber{
		Conn:    natsConn,
		Subject: domain.SubjectTaskAnswerActivity,
		Queue:   "ms-student-service",
		Handler: func(ctx context.Context, msg []byte) error {
			var payload struct {
				AnswerID string `json:"answerId"`
				UserID   string `json:"userId"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &payload); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if payload.AnswerID == "" || payload.UserID == "" {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			return activityUC.Handle(ctx, answer.ActivityAnswerInput{
				AnswerID:  payload.AnswerID,
				StudentID: payload.UserID,
			})
		},
	}
	if err := activitySubscriber.Subscribe(ctx); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("nats activity subscribe error", zap.Error(err))
	}

	teacherAssistanceSubscriber := natsconsumer.TeacherAssistanceSubscriber{
		Conn:    natsConn,
		Handler: teacherAssistanceUseCase.Handle,
	}
	if err := teacherAssistanceSubscriber.Subscribe(ctx); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("nats teacher assistance subscribe error", zap.Error(err))
	}

	srv := &http.Server{Addr: cfg.HTTPListenAddress(), Handler: router}

	go func() {
		logger.Info("starting http server", zap.String("port", cfg.HTTPPort))
		if err := srv.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			logger.Fatal("http server error", zap.Error(err))
		}
	}()

	stop := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(stop, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-stop
	logger.Info("shutting down")
	ctxShutdown, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(cfg.ShutdownTimeout)*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := srv.Shutdown(ctxShutdown); err != nil {
		logger.Error("shutdown error", zap.Error(err))
	}
}

func runOutboxRelay(ctx context.Context, logger *zap.Logger, relay outboxuc.Relay, interval time.Duration) {
	if interval <= 0 {
		logger.Error("invalid outbox poll interval", zap.Duration("interval", interval))
		return
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
			claimed, err := relay.ProcessBatch(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				logger.Warn("student outbox relay batch failed", zap.Int("claimed", claimed), zap.Error(err))
			}
		}
	}
}
